sloka: ते समुद्रेषु गिरिषु वनेषु च सरःसु च ।वानरा वानरान् सर्वान् राम हेतोः अचोदयन् ॥४-३७-१८॥
transliteration: te samudreṣu giriṣu vaneṣu ca saraḥsu ca ।vānarā vānarān sarvān rāma hetoḥ acodayan ॥4-37-18॥

translations.english: The messenger monkeys drove in all those living on the sea shore, mountains, forests as well as banks of lakes in order to serve the cause of Rama.
